projects.deletionFailure: Products continue to run, but no explicit owner remains for cross-project contraction, promotion/deletion decisions, shared research falsifiers, stable family map or the loop that compares local evidence and revises common claims.

crossProjectLaws: Repository topology is not an authority stack.

Semantic judgment, state-contract ownership, persistence carrier, local execution proof, native external/domain fact, mapping/derivation, reconciliation identity, consequence admission and acceptance verification are independent relations.
A relation is asserted only when relevant to the current question; no universal row must be completed.
Owner-native fact remains authoritative through mapping and projection.
Execution or transport success never manufactures higher-level semantic success.
Local/domain semantic home, classical mechanical delegation and shared promotion are independent decisions.
New shared layers require repeated materially different consumers plus a residual non-bypassable responsibility that neighbors/classical substrate cannot safely own.
Negative/null/no-op/abstain outcomes are legitimate evidence and may justify deletion or non-promotion.
Human-response claims require human evidence; Agent-observer or deterministic evidence cannot silently substitute for it.
Current product, accepted experimental target and historical evidence are different lifecycle facts.
